# AI Marking (aimarking.ai)
An AI-powered platform for marking handwritten exam past papers across UK and International qualifications.

## Supported Handwritten Exam Levels
- UK: GCSE, A-Level, AS-Level, SQA National 5, Level 3 Core Maths
- International: Cambridge & Edexcel IGCSE, International A-Level (IAL), International AS, Cambridge O Level, IB Diploma (HL/SL), and College Board AP® Hybrid STEM Free-Response (FRQ)

## Key Features
- Built-in official AQA, Pearson Edexcel & OCR past papers and mark schemes (GCSE & A-Level Maths, GCSE English Language) plus an auto-growing official library from verified user uploads.
- Bring-Your-Own Mark Scheme: Upload any handwritten past paper together with its official mark scheme PDF (mark scheme pages never count toward page limits).
- Dual Marking Engine: Spatial handwriting/equation/graph marking + Levels-of-Response (LoR) essay rubric evaluation.
- Instant Examiner Feedback: Line-by-line annotations, step-by-step guidance, and multi-scale grade tracking.

## Target Audience
- Secondary & Sixth-Form Students (UK & International)
- Private Tutors & Tuition Centres
- Secondary School Teachers
